name: Akka Mahadevi
shortBio: Twelfth-century Kannada poet-philosopher of the Virashaiva (Lingayat) movement whose vachanas radicalized non-dual devotional metaphysics while repudiating caste hierarchy and patriarchal domesticity.
centralQuestion: How does ecstatic devotion to the divine absolute shatter social conventions of caste, gender, and embodied possession?

keyWorks.title: Vachanas of Akka Mahadevi
keyWorks.description: Collected Kannada philosophical prose-poems articulated in dialogues with Basavanna and the Anubhava Mantapa rejecting social ritualism for direct spiritual equality.
